import random, json
random.seed(11)
TOK=["\\w","\\W","\\d","\\D","\\s","\\S","[\\w]","[^\\w]","[\\d]","[a-z]","[^a-z]","a","å","1","_"," ","+","*","?","{2}","(",")","|",".","^","$","[\\w-]","[\\wå]","-"]
SUB=["räk abc","aåb","a b_1","ÅÄÖ xyz","a1å_","","  ","a b","١٢ ab","aåb aåb"]
cases=[];seen=set()
while len(cases)<3000:
    p="".join(random.choice(TOK) for _ in range(random.randint(1,4)))
    s=random.choice(SUB)

import random, json, sys
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 7)
N=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 4000
TOK=["a","b","x","1","2"," ","  ","\n","\t","#","# c","#c\n","\\ ","\\#","\\n","[ab]","[a b]","[#]","[^ab]","[]a]","(",")","(?:","*","+","?","{2}","{2,3}","{2, 3}","{","}","|","^","$","\\w","\\d","\\s","\\.",".","-",",","\\\\","(a)","\\{"]
SUB=["a b","ab","a#b","a  b\nc","aab 12","x{2}y","a{2,3}","","\n","a\tb #c","abab","12 34"]
cases=[]
seen=set()
while len(cases)<N:
    p="".join(random.choice(TOK) for _ in range(random.randint(1,6)))
    s=random.choice(SUB)
    k=(p,s)
    if k in seen: continue
    seen.add(k)
    cases.append([p,s])
open("cases.json","w").write(json.dumps(cases))
print(len(cases))

import json, itertools
NON=["å","ä","ö","é","ñ","€","—"]
PATS=[]
for c in NON:
    PATS += ["[\\w%s]+"%c, "[\\w%s]"%c, "[%s\\w]*"%c, "\\D[\\w]*", "[\\w][^a-z]", "[\\w-]+", "\\w+%s?"%c]
SUB=["räk","aåb","x é y","naïve café","ÅÄÖ","a—b","1€2","abc"]

import re, json, sys
cases = json.load(open("cases.json"))
FL = {"X": re.X, "XA": re.X | re.A, "A": re.A, "XI": re.X | re.I, "XM": re.X | re.M, "XS": re.X | re.S, "0": 0}
mode = sys.argv[1]
start = int(sys.argv[2])
f = FL[mode]
i = start
while i < len(cases):
    p, s = cases[i]
    try:
        r = repr(re.findall(p, s, f))
    except NotImplementedError as e:
        m = str(e)
        r = "UNSUP" if m[:21] == "pygram: unsupported: " else "ERR:NIE"
    except Exception as e:
        r = "ERR:" + type(e).__name__
    print(str(i) + "\t" + r)
    i += 1
